name: Modules.BLE.MutableCharacteristic
summary: A characteristic of a local peripheral’s service.
description: It objects represent the characteristics of a local peripheral’s service. This class adds write access to many of the properties in the Characteristic class, which it inherits from.

properties.name: permissions
properties.summary: The permissions of the characteristic value. It is only present if this JavaScript object represents a mutable characteristic.

properties.name: subscribedCentrals
properties.summary: For notifying characteristics, the set of currently subscribed centrals.
